title: Monterey Cannery Row Scavenger Hunt
includes: Access to the interactive scavenger hunt and challenges you follow & find with your smartphone.
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Wear comfortable shoes! You'll walk about 1 mile along this scavenger hunt activity.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on an engaging scavenger hunt through the vibrant streets of Monterey, California. Explore Cannery Row and discover its unique and diverse history. Take in the historic stories, including those of a unique friendship between an influential scientist (Doc Ricketts) and a famous author (John Steinbeck).

Delve into the happening Cannery Row. Explore and see the many unique shops, restaurants and galleries. Stroll past McAbee beach and see the Cannery Row Monument. Marvel at the amazing views of Monterey Bay. Explore at your own pace and see the best of what Monterey has to offer. Ready to discover Monterey and Cannery Row in a whole new way? Let the adventure begin!
